cases.title: Select Available Seats and Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Precondition: Webpage is loaded. Steps: Click an available seat without the occupied class and select a movie from data-testid="movie-select". Expected: The seat is marked as selected, data-testid="selected-count" increments, and data-testid="total-price" updates correctly based on the number of selected seats multiplied by the movie price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Precondition: Webpage is loaded. Steps: Click on a seat marked with the occupied class. Expected: The occupied seat remains unselectable and does not affect the selected count or total price.

cases.title: Deselect Seats and Update Totals
cases.description: Precondition: One or more seats are currently selected. Steps: Click on a currently selected seat again to deselect it. Expected: The seat is unmarked, data-testid="selected-count" decreases, and data-testid="total-price" decreases accordingly.

cases.title: Change Movie Selection Dynamically Updates Price
cases.description: Precondition: Seats are already selected and a movie is chosen. Steps: Change the movie selection from the dropdown (data-testid="movie-select"). Expected: The total price updates according to the new ticket price while maintaining the existing count of selected seats.

cases.title: Restore State from Local Storage on Page Load
cases.description: Precondition: Local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'. Steps: Load the 'Movie Seat Booking' webpage. Expected: The corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and the movie dropdown matches 'selectedMovieIndex'.

cases.title: Default State When Local Storage is Empty
cases.description: Precondition: Local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' or 'selectedMovieIndex'. Steps: Load the webpage. Expected: No seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and test cases are clear, well-grounded, and mutually consistent.

analysis.analysis: For e2edev_bench_03-R-1, R-2, R-4, and R-5: Precondition is the webpage is loaded with default movie selected and available/occupied seats rendered. Action is clicking an available seat (e.g., data-testid='seat-1-1') or an occupied seat. Expected behavior is that clicking an available seat toggles its selection status, updates selected-count, updates total-price based on the movie price, stores state in localStorage, and prevents selection of occupied seats. For changing movies, action is selecting a different movie from data-testid='movie-select', and expected behavior is that the ticket price and total-price update dynamically while maintaining the selected seat count. For e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Precondition is localStorage contains or does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'. Action is loading the webpage. Expected behavior is that if keys exist, matching seats are marked 'selected' and the dropdown matches 'selectedMovieIndex'; otherwise, no seats are selected and the dropdown defaults to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.
